title: Ferrugo
summary: An open-world action prototype in Unreal Engine 5 that switches between 2D and 3D play.
intro: An open-world action prototype set on a desolate future colony, switching between 2D and 3D play.
After a catastrophe known as the Great Dawn, the abandoned colony has lost its technology and contact with other colonies, and its survivors have split into rival factions.

details.label: Context
details.value: Semester project, Ateliér Game Design, FMK UTB
